# Resource: tfe_provider_set

Creates, updates and destroys provider sets.

~> **Warning:** This resource is currently in beta and isn't generally available to all users. It is subject to change or be removed.

## Example Usage

```typescript
import * as constructs from "constructs";
import * as cdktf from "cdktf";
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import * as tfe from "./.gen/providers/tfe";
class MyConvertedCode extends cdktf.TerraformStack {
  constructor(scope: constructs.Construct, name: string) {
    super(scope, name);
    new tfe.providerSet.ProviderSet(this, "standard", {
      description: "Reusable provider config for selected workspaces",
      name: "example-provider-set",
      organization: "example-org",
      priority: true,
      providerConfigHcl: 'provider "aws" {\n  region = "us-east-1"\n}\n',
      providerSource: "registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws",
      workspaceIds: ["ws-exampleaaaa11111", "ws-examplebbbb22222"],
    });
  }
}

```

```terraform
# Write-only configuration

variable "aws_access_key" {
  type      = string
  ephemeral = true
}

variable "aws_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "tfe_provider_set" "write_only" {
  name            = "example-provider-set-write-only"
  description     = "Reusable provider config with write-only secrets"
  organization    = "example-org"
  provider_source = "registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws"
  workspace_ids = [
    "ws-exampleaaaa11111",
    "ws-examplebbbb22222",
  ]

  provider_config_hcl_wo_version = 1
  provider_config_hcl_wo         = <<-EOT
  provider "aws" {
    region     = "us-east-1"
    access_key = var.aws_access_key
    secret_key = var.aws_secret_key
  }
  EOT
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the provider set.
- `providerSource` (String) Source address of the provider, e.g. `registryTerraformIo/hashicorp/tfe`.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `description` (String) The description of the provider set.
- `global` (Boolean) Whether the provider set applies globally. Defaults to `false`. When `global` is `false` or omitted, at least one of `workspaceIds` or `projectIds` must be set.
- `organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.
- `priority` (Boolean) Whether the provider set takes priority over provider sets with more specific scopes. Defaults to `false`.
- `projectIds` (Set of String) IDs of the projects attached to the provider set. Required if `global` is `false` or omitted and `workspaceIds` is not set. Cannot be set if `global` is `true`.
- `providerConfigHcl` (String) The provider configuration HCL stored in Terraform state.
- `providerConfigHclWo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Provider configuration HCL that is never stored in state. Cannot be used with `providerConfigHcl`. Requires `providerConfigHclWoVersion`.
- `providerConfigHclWoVersion` (Number) Version identifier required when `providerConfigHclWo` is set to trigger updates.
- `workspaceIds` (Set of String) IDs of the workspaces attached to the provider set. Required if `global` is `false` or omitted and `projectIds` is not set. Cannot be set if `global` is `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the provider set.



## Import

tfe_provider_set can be imported using an identity. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = tfe_provider_set.example
  identity = {
    id           = "provset-uomQZysH9ou42ZYY"
    organization = "my-org-name"
    hostname     = "app.terraform.io"
  }
}
```
